limits: Protocol fixtures validate program/protocol behavior; channel-provided real models remain valid model evidence. No extra paid account is required.
No new model quality, coding success rate, benchmark ranking or OpenCode parity claim.
No native filesystem/process backend changes. Platform skips are not passes; local WSL is not native Ubuntu CI.
No remote CI or full Python/client/macOS matrix claim. Repair the prior exact-SHA gate before dispatching the next CI-enabled batch.
Configured startup snapshot only; no arbitrary URL, remote discovery, OAuth, favorites/recent model preferences, variants or config hot reload.
Switch only when idle; confirmation and successful local preparation precede one-shot commit. A completed switch is not rolled back by later cancellation.
Private session files are not encrypted; old branch is retained and may contain prior provider metadata. Credential values are not persisted in binding.
Per-provider usage begins with a new Provider instance; prior usage is reported separately.
